More 
Major is a character introduced in Taimanin RPGX and reappearing in the Online Universes.

A Cyborg of Task Force G, she would later desert.

This body of mine can be improved over and over again. Convenient, isn't it?
Major


Personality
Very strong-willed and loud compared to a Yanki girl. She's afraid of nothing and will most likely be the first to attack the enemy. When in private, she's more lady like and a little shy. She keeps her house tidy and mostly feminine. Her loyalty to G is shaky though, she would often follow the orders given like a soldier without questioning it, she often does not like to think about what she does. Major was often annoyed by the many missions given by G and potentially can become a deserter, preferring the freedom. She is rather simple-minded, convinced easily, regardless she is also caring and protective of juniors.

Originally became a cyborg, desiring power that no one could beat, but is worried she has become a tool, and will be thrown away eventually. Developed a rivalry with Fuuma Saika and often attempts to act more tough around her.

Appearance
She has short grayish black wearing a military style white outfit with red flame like pattern on the edges, giving her the semblance of a delinquent. Under her jacket that she wears like a coat, she has a black tank top that leaves her belly out and highlights her assets.

History
Major 4
Background
A UFS officer. Former UFS Navy Special Forces, now a member of the UFS Department of State Task Force G.

The name "Major" is a code name, and her real name is still unknown. Major is a human cyborg, her muscles are enforced with metal fiber, and she can break an ogre with her bare hands. Used to work with Fuuma Danjo and Fuuma Saika. Regardless, often displays, a disregard for G itself.

Timeline RPGX
In the year 2083, leaked information of the Nisha Ninja Troops, allowed Task Force G to sent Major to Saika.

While Kotaro, was in a contest to get chocolate from Saika, he got her location from Minasaki. As he found Major, threading Saika to follow her or return her legs to "G". Fuuma Tokiko, which tracked Kotaro for the contest, so he wouldn't cheat also joined and Major started to flee.

She pretended to have a voice controlled drone, but Kotaro concluded somebody else close by controlled it, with Tokiko taking the other person out. Major's physical strength was still far above Kotaro and the others, but instead of fighting her head on, Fuuma Saika instead put her into an illusion with no other allies to break her out.

She was captured, and imprisoned in Gosha, but later freed by the Internal Affairs Bureau and joined their ranks. In an attack of Gosha Village by the reformed Igawa Elder Revolt Group, she joined the forces of Fürst, Task Force G, Internal Affairs and Wraith Faction but after the battle was lost, she deserted and ran away from G and the other factions, confused by how complicated everything had gotten.

While, still viewing Taimanin as potential enemies, she now was hunted down by G's CA, which feared she could leak information. She tried to shake off her pursuers in Amidahara and would get some help after the Gaiza Massacre and destruction of the Yomihara Gate. As she was attacked, the close by Kugimitsu Chloe and Kamimura Maika (Future) ran into the agents of G, which attacked her. Maika helped after one of the agents pushed into her, and was rather rude. Afterward, Maika Major and Chloe, ate together. Maika suggested that if Major was unsure where to go, she should just stay at Amidahara Prison, in which Chloe worked. Major agreed but, not to be too rude, offered help to Chloe gathering a special ingrained found in Chocolate Slime.

Timeline Action
Can join the Taimanin Task Force as a supporter, her current allegiance to G and any conflict to the Taimanin has not been mentioned. Appears to have joined the group being saved by Kotaro now living in Gosha Village.

Powers/Abilities
Major 8
Main Weapon: Baseball bat (made of a special metal that can't dent)

Cyborg Enhancement: Every muscle in her body is strengthened by a special metal fiber, endowing her entire body with the defense of an armored car, and strength enough to kill a man-eating Ogre with her bare hands.
Electric Attack

While it stated her bat can not bend, in her RPGX unit much later as she is abandoned by G, it now bend.
